name: sutra-harness
description: The automatic half of Sutra: a layered operating contract at session start, short rule cards when they apply, hidden-Unicode warnings, a compaction brief, a verify-before-stop nudge under the strict profile, and the build-orchestrator workflow. Runs one Bash hook script, and installs the sutra skills plugin as a dependency.

profile.title: Sutra profile
profile.description: lite, standard, strict, or off. Empty means standard, which a repository's .sutra file may raise to strict. The SUTRA_PROFILE environment variable overrides this setting.
